title: Leviticus Chapter 20 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Leviticus chapter 20 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Leviticus Chapter 20 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Leviticus Chapter 20.

questions.question: Who did the LORD speak to in Leviticus 20?
questions.correctAnswer: Moses
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:1 states that the LORD spake unto Moses.

questions.question: What is the punishment for anyone of the children of Israel or strangers who gives any of his seed to Molech?
options: They shall be put to death
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be put to death
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:2 commands that such a person shall surely be put to death.

questions.question: How shall the people of the land execute the person who gives seed to Molech?
questions.correctAnswer: Stoning with stones
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:2 specifies that the people of the land shall stone him with stones.

questions.question: What will the LORD do to the man who gives seed to Molech according to Leviticus 20?
options: Set His face against him and cut him off
questions.correctAnswer: Set His face against him and cut him off
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:3 states that the LORD will set His face against that man and cut him off from among his people.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 20, what will happen if the people of the land hide their eyes and do not kill the man who gives seed to Molech?
options: The LORD will set His face against that man and his family
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD will set His face against that man and his family
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:4-5 explains that if the people hide their eyes and kill him not, the LORD will set His face against that man and his family and cut them off.

questions.question: Who will the LORD cut off from among the people if they go a whoring after Molech?
options: The man and all that go a whoring after him
questions.correctAnswer: The man and all that go a whoring after him
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:5 states that the LORD will cut off the man and all who commit whoredom with Molech from among their people.

questions.question: What does the LORD say about a soul that turns after familiar spirits and wizards?
options: The LORD will set His face against that soul and cut him off
The soul will become a prophet
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD will set His face against that soul and cut him off
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:6 states that the LORD will set His face against the soul that turns after familiar spirits and wizards and will cut him off.

questions.question: What command does the LORD give to the people in Leviticus 20:7?
options: Sanctify yourselves and be ye holy
questions.correctAnswer: Sanctify yourselves and be ye holy
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:7 commands the people to sanctify themselves and be holy because the LORD is their God.

questions.question: In Leviticus 20, who is described as the one who sanctifies the people?
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:8 says, 'I am the LORD which sanctify you,' making clear that the LORD sanctifies the people.

questions.question: What is the punishment for anyone who curses his father or mother according to Leviticus 20?
questions.correctAnswer: Surely put to death
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:9 states that everyone who curses his father or mother shall surely be put to death.

questions.question: True or False: The LORD commands that anyone who curses his parents shall have his blood upon himself.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:9 explains that the person who curses his father or mother shall have his blood upon him.

questions.question: True or False: According to Leviticus 20, the LORD will bless those who go a whoring after Molech.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:5 states that the LORD will set His face against those who go a whoring after Molech and cut them off.

questions.question: True or False: The LORD commands the Israelites to keep His statutes and do them because He sanctifies them.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:8 commands the people to keep the LORD's statutes and do them because He sanctifies them.

questions.question: True or False: The LORD will not take action against those who hide their eyes from the man giving seed to Molech.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:4-5 states that if the people hide their eyes and kill him not, the LORD will set His face against that man and his family and cut them off.

questions.question: In Leviticus 20, which command comes first?
options: Whosoever gives seed to Molech shall be put to death
Curseth his father or mother shall be put to death
Keep my statutes and do them
questions.correctAnswer: Whosoever gives seed to Molech shall be put to death
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:2 contains the first command about death for giving seed to Molech, which comes before the other commands listed.

medium.title: Leviticus Chapter 20 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Leviticus Chapter 20 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 20:10, what is the prescribed punishment for a man who commits adultery with another man's wife?
options: He shall be put to death
He shall be forgiven after repentance
questions.correctAnswer: He shall be put to death
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:10 clearly states that the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death as punishment for adultery.

questions.question: What does Leviticus 20:11 say about a man who lies with his father's wife?
options: They shall be put to death
They shall be forgiven by the community
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be put to death
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:11 states that both the man and his father's wife shall surely be put to death because he hath uncovered his father's nakedness.

questions.question: If a man lies with his daughter-in-law, what judgment does Leviticus 20:12 prescribe?
options: They shall be put to death
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be put to death
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:12 specifies that both the man and his daughter-in-law shall surely be put to death because they have wrought confusion.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 20:13, what is the consequence for a man who lies with another man as he would with a woman?
options: They shall be put to death
They shall be forgiven after repentance
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be put to death
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:13 declares that both men have committed an abomination and shall surely be put to death.

questions.question: What does Leviticus 20:14 describe as wickedness that results in being burnt with fire?
options: A man taking a wife and her mother
A man lying with a beast
A man lying with his sister
A man lying with his daughter-in-law
questions.correctAnswer: A man taking a wife and her mother
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:14 states that if a man takes a wife and her mother, it is wickedness and they shall be burnt with fire to prevent wickedness among the people.

questions.question: What are the instructions and consequences in Leviticus 20:15 for a man lying with a beast?
options: He shall be put to death and the beast shall be slain
He shall be exiled and the beast spared
He shall be fined and the beast killed
He shall be forgiven if he repents
questions.correctAnswer: He shall be put to death and the beast shall be slain
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:15 commands that the man shall surely be put to death and the beast shall be slain because of this abomination.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 20:16, what is the punishment if a woman lies with a beast?
options: She shall be put to death along with the beast
questions.correctAnswer: She shall be put to death along with the beast
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:16 states that the woman and beast shall be killed and put to death, and their blood shall be upon them.

questions.question: What does Leviticus 20:17 say about a man who takes his sister and sees her nakedness?
options: It is acceptable if they marry
It is a wicked thing and they shall be cut off
They shall be forgiven by the community
questions.correctAnswer: It is a wicked thing and they shall be cut off
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:17 declares that a man who takes his sister and sees her nakedness commits a wicked act and both shall be cut off in the sight of their people.

questions.question: How does Leviticus 20:18 describe the consequence for a man who lies with a woman during her sickness?
options: They shall both be cut off from among their people
They shall be forgiven after repentance
questions.correctAnswer: They shall both be cut off from among their people
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:18 states that both the man and the woman shall be cut off from among their people for uncovering her fountain, which refers to her menstrual sickness.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 20:19 forbids uncovering the nakedness of a mother's sister or father's sister.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:19 explicitly forbids uncovering the nakedness of near kin such as a mother's sister or father's sister, stating they shall bear their iniquity.

questions.question: What consequence does Leviticus 20:20 assign to a man who lies with his uncle's wife?
questions.correctAnswer: They shall die childless
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:20 says that the man and his uncle's wife shall bear their sin and die childless as a consequence of uncovering his uncle's nakedness.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 20:21, what is said about a man who takes his brother's wife?
options: It is an unclean thing and they shall be childless
It is allowed if the brother has died
questions.correctAnswer: It is an unclean thing and they shall be childless
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:21 teaches that taking a brother's wife is an unclean act and they shall be childless because he hath uncovered his brother's nakedness.

questions.question: What does Leviticus 20:22 promise will happen if the children of Israel keep all God's statutes and judgments?
options: The land will spue them out
They will be blessed with wealth
The land where God brings them will not spue them out
They will be forgiven of all sins
questions.correctAnswer: The land where God brings them will not spue them out
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:22 promises that if Israel keeps God's statutes and judgments, the land He brings them to will not spue them out.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 20:23 states that God abhors the nations before Israel because they committed the same sins described earlier in the chapter.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:23 explains that God cast out the nations before Israel because they committed all these abominations, and therefore He abhorred them.

questions.question: What does Leviticus 20:24 say God has done to Israel compared to other people?
options: Separated them and given them a land flowing with milk and honey
questions.correctAnswer: Separated them and given them a land flowing with milk and honey
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:24 states that God has separated Israel from other people and will give them a land flowing with milk and honey to possess.

hard.title: Leviticus Chapter 20 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Leviticus Chapter 20.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 20:19, which family members' nakedness are forbidden to be uncovered?
questions.correctAnswer: Mother's sister and father's sister
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:19 explicitly prohibits uncovering the nakedness of one's mother's sister and father's sister, emphasizing the closeness of kinship and the bearing of iniquity for violating this law.

questions.question: What consequence does Leviticus 20:20 state for a man who lies with his uncle's wife?
options: They shall bear their sin and die childless
They shall be exiled from the community
They shall be put to death by stoning
They shall pay a fine to the priest
questions.correctAnswer: They shall bear their sin and die childless
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:20 prescribes that a man who lies with his uncle's wife shall bear their sin and die childless, emphasizing the severity of this forbidden sexual relation.

questions.question: Leviticus 20:21 states that taking a brother's wife is considered what?
options: An unclean thing resulting in childlessness
questions.correctAnswer: An unclean thing resulting in childlessness
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:21 explicitly says that taking a brother’s wife is unclean and that they shall be childless, highlighting the prohibition and its consequences.

questions.question: What is the purpose of keeping statutes and judgments according to Leviticus 20:22?
options: So the land will not spue the people out
To become the most powerful nation
questions.correctAnswer: So the land will not spue the people out
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:22 teaches that obedience to God's statutes prevents the land from rejecting or 'spewing out' the inhabitants, showing the connection between holiness and land possession.

questions.question: Leviticus 20:23 warns Israel not to walk in the manners of which group?
options: The nations which God cast out before them
questions.correctAnswer: The nations which God cast out before them
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:23 instructs Israel not to follow the customs of the nations God had previously cast out due to their abominable acts, underscoring the call to holiness.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 20:24, what description is given of the land God promises to Israel?
options: A land flowing with milk and honey
A land of mountains and valleys
A land of rivers and gold
questions.correctAnswer: A land flowing with milk and honey
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:24 describes the land promised to Israel as flowing with milk and honey, symbolizing abundance and God's provision.

questions.question: In Leviticus 20:25, what distinction are the Israelites commanded to make?
options: Between clean and unclean beasts and fowls
questions.correctAnswer: Between clean and unclean beasts and fowls
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:25 commands Israel to distinguish between clean and unclean animals, which is part of maintaining ritual purity and avoiding abominations.

questions.question: What is the theological reason given in Leviticus 20:26 for Israel to be holy?
options: Because the LORD is holy and has separated them from other peoples
To be better than other nations
questions.correctAnswer: Because the LORD is holy and has separated them from other peoples
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:26 states Israel must be holy as God is holy and has separated them to be His own, emphasizing covenant identity and holiness as reflection of God’s character.

questions.question: Leviticus 20:27 prescribes what penalty for a man or woman who has a familiar spirit or is a wizard?
options: They shall be put to death by stoning
They shall be exiled for seven years
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be put to death by stoning
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:27 prescribes death by stoning for those practicing necromancy or witchcraft, reflecting the seriousness of such forbidden practices in Israelite law.

questions.question: Which earlier chapter in Leviticus contains a similar prohibition about lying with mankind as with a woman, echoing Leviticus 20:13?
questions.correctAnswer: Leviticus 18
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18 contains earlier laws forbidding same-sex relations (18:22), which is echoed and reinforced in Leviticus 20:13, showing the theme's continuity.

questions.question: The term 'cut off' used repeatedly in Leviticus 20 (e.g., verses 3, 5, 6) in the original Hebrew often implies what?
options: Excommunication or divine judgment resulting in removal from the community
questions.correctAnswer: Excommunication or divine judgment resulting in removal from the community
questions.explanation: The Hebrew term for 'cut off' (karath) in Leviticus 20 indicates being severed from the people, often meaning death or divine removal from the covenant community.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage echoes the call for holiness found in Leviticus 20:7 and 20:26?
questions.explanation: 1 Peter 1:15-16 exhorts believers to be holy as God is holy, directly echoing the holiness commands in Leviticus 20:7 and 20:26, showing fulfillment in the New Testament.

questions.question: Which literary device is prominently used in Leviticus 20 to emphasize the seriousness of forbidden sexual relations?
questions.correctAnswer: Repetition and parallelism
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20 repeats similar prohibitions with parallel structure to emphasize the severity and breadth of forbidden sexual sins, aiding memorability and impact.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 20:18 forbids sexual relations with a woman during her menstrual period, prescribing that both parties be cut off from their people.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:18 forbids lying with a woman during her 'sickness' (menstrual period), stating both shall be cut off, underscoring ritual purity laws.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 20:14 allows a man to take a wife and her mother, as long as they are not burned with fire.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:14 explicitly condemns a man taking a wife and her mother as wickedness and prescribes burning them with fire to purge wickedness.

theological.title: Leviticus Chapter 20 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Leviticus Chapter 20 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What divine attribute is primarily demonstrated by God's command to stone those who give their children to Molech?
questions.correctAnswer: God's justice
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:2-3 shows God's justice in punishing those who profane His sanctuary by sacrificing their children to Molech, indicating that He will 'cut him off' and bring judgment upon him.

questions.question: Which doctrine is taught by the warning against cursing one's parents with the penalty of death?
options: Doctrine of the family and authority
questions.correctAnswer: Doctrine of the family and authority
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:9 establishes the sacredness of parental authority and the seriousness of honoring parents, teaching the doctrine that family order is ordained by God and must be respected.

questions.question: How does Leviticus 20:7-8 relate to the broader biblical theme of sanctification?
options: It shows sanctification as an optional moral guideline.
It reveals sanctification as a divine command linked to God's identity.
It presents sanctification as solely a ritual practice.
It teaches sanctification only applies to priests.
questions.correctAnswer: It reveals sanctification as a divine command linked to God's identity.
questions.explanation: Verses 7-8 command the Israelites to 'sanctify yourselves' because God is holy and sanctifies them, showing sanctification as integral to God's nature and His people’s relationship with Him.

questions.question: What combined teaching about sin and community discipline is conveyed by Leviticus 20:4-5 and Leviticus 20:27?
options: God allows sin if the community ignores it.
God punishes individuals but not their families.
God's judgment extends to those who tolerate sin among them.
God only punishes sorcery but not idolatry.
questions.correctAnswer: God's judgment extends to those who tolerate sin among them.
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:4-5 and 20:27 show that not only the sinner but the community that fails to act against sin (e.g., idolatry or witchcraft) will face God's judgment and be cut off.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 20:13, what is the prescribed penalty for a man lying with another man as with a woman, and what does this indicate about the seriousness of this sin?
questions.correctAnswer: Death by stoning
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:13 states that both men shall 'surely be put to death' for this abomination, indicating the gravity with which God views this sin within His covenant community.

questions.question: What theological principle is expressed by the repeated phrase 'their blood shall be upon them' as seen in verses such as Leviticus 20:9 and 20:11?
options: Human responsibility for sin and its consequences
questions.correctAnswer: Human responsibility for sin and its consequences
questions.explanation: The phrase in verses like 20:9 and 20:11 emphasizes that individuals bear full responsibility for their sins and the resulting judgment, underscoring the doctrine of moral accountability.

questions.question: How does Leviticus 20:22-24 connect the obedience to God's statutes with the covenant promise of land inheritance?
options: Obedience is unrelated to land possession.
Disobedience leads to immediate exile without hope.
Obedience secures God's blessing and possession of the promised land.
Land inheritance is based solely on military conquest.
questions.correctAnswer: Obedience secures God's blessing and possession of the promised land.
questions.explanation: Verses 22-24 teach that keeping God's statutes is essential so that the land God gives will not reject them, and that inheritance of the land flowing with milk and honey depends on covenant faithfulness.

questions.question: What attribute of God is highlighted in Leviticus 20:26 when He says, 'I the LORD am holy, and have severed you from other people'?
questions.correctAnswer: God's holiness and separateness
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:26 emphasizes God's holy nature and His act of setting apart Israel from other nations, reflecting His distinctiveness and purity.

questions.question: Which doctrinal truth about forbidden sexual relations is taught by the combined regulations in Leviticus 20:11-12 and Leviticus 20:17-21?
options: Sexual freedom is unrestricted in the covenant community.
God forbids incestuous relationships to maintain purity.
Only adultery is prohibited, not family relations.
Sexual sins are private matters without communal impact.
questions.correctAnswer: God forbids incestuous relationships to maintain purity.
questions.explanation: These verses collectively forbid sexual relations with close relatives, emphasizing God's concern for moral purity and order in the community.

questions.question: What is the apologetic answer to the skeptic's claim that Leviticus 20:15-16 promotes cruelty towards animals?
options: These laws show God's arbitrary cruelty.
The text prohibits all contact with animals.
These laws reflect God's judgment on grave sin, including bestiality, to protect holiness.
Animals are given equal moral status as humans.
questions.correctAnswer: These laws reflect God's judgment on grave sin, including bestiality, to protect holiness.
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:15-16 prescribe death for bestiality, demonstrating God's commitment to maintaining holiness and preventing defilement, not cruelty without cause (cf. also Deuteronomy 22:5).

questions.question: How does Leviticus 20:6 demonstrate God's attitude towards occult practices such as consulting familiar spirits and wizards?
options: God tolerates such practices among His people.
God is indifferent to occult activities.
God opposes and will cut off those who pursue them.
questions.correctAnswer: God opposes and will cut off those who pursue them.
questions.explanation: Verse 6 explicitly states that God will set His face against those who turn to familiar spirits and wizards, cutting them off from among their people, highlighting His rejection of occultism.

questions.question: What does the combination of Leviticus 20:25 and Leviticus 20:23 teach about Israel's call to holiness in relation to surrounding nations?
options: Israel should adopt the customs of surrounding nations.
God commands Israel to distinguish themselves by avoiding pagan practices.
Holiness is only about internal attitudes, not external actions.
Israel's holiness is identical to that of other nations.
questions.correctAnswer: God commands Israel to distinguish themselves by avoiding pagan practices.
questions.explanation: Verses 23 and 25 command Israel not to follow the nations' sinful ways and to differentiate between clean and unclean, reinforcing their call to distinct holiness.

questions.question: What theological significance does the demand in Leviticus 20:14, forbidding marriage to a wife and her mother, convey?
options: It upholds family honor and prevents wickedness among the people.
It encourages freedom in marital arrangements.
It has no moral or theological significance.
questions.correctAnswer: It upholds family honor and prevents wickedness among the people.
questions.explanation: Leviticus 20:14 condemns such marriages as wickedness and prescribes burning to remove this evil, emphasizing God's concern for moral order and community purity.

questions.question: What do Leviticus 20:18 and 20:19 collectively teach about sexual relations and family boundaries?
options: Sexual relations with close kin or during menstruation are permitted.
God forbids uncovering the nakedness of close relatives and sexual relations during a woman's menstrual period.
Sexual relations are only regulated by civil law, not divine command.
Family boundaries are not significant in sexual ethics.
questions.correctAnswer: God forbids uncovering the nakedness of close relatives and sexual relations during a woman's menstrual period.
questions.explanation: These verses prohibit sexual relations that violate family boundaries or occur at inappropriate times, reflecting God's design for holiness and purity.

questions.question: What narrative arc does Leviticus 20:24 reveal about God's purpose in separating Israel from other nations?
options: To prepare Israel as a holy people to inherit the promised land.
To make Israel indistinguishable from other peoples.
questions.correctAnswer: To prepare Israel as a holy people to inherit the promised land.
questions.explanation: Verse 24 indicates that God separated Israel to give them the land flowing with milk and honey, pointing to His redemptive plan to establish a covenant people set apart for Himself.
